snippet.title: Matcha Flavoured Datapack Trailer
snippet.description:
You can find the datapack here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/matcha-flavoured 

Special thank you to Ciren, for composing the “Golden” Music Disc. Seriously, Ciren, you’re amazing.

If you think YOU can make a killer music disc *or* would like to donate a track to the pack, email me!
If you think YOU can make better textures and would like to donate some for the pack, email me!


Mods I recommend using with the pack:
    Easy Shulker Boxes
       https://modrinth.com/mod/easy-shulker-boxes  
    Bundle Upgrade
       https://modrinth.com/mod/bundle-upgrade 
    Ambient Sounds
       https://modrinth.com/mod/ambientsounds 
    Cosy Critters & Creepy Crawlies
       https://modrinth.com/mod/cosy-critters  
    Particle Rain
       https://modrinth.com/mod/particle-rain 
    Better Clouds
       https://modrinth.com/mod/better-clouds 

    These mods can be easily added and removed and I’ve had no issue loading a new version without
    them. In other words, they seem to be ever-green, and when the authors stop updating them, you 
    don't have to worry about the mods corrupting your world upon removal. 

Inspirational Artists & Works*¹*
    Raspberry Flavoured - Raspmary
       Go check out Raspmary’s modpack here: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/modpacks/raspberry-flavoured 
       I really enjoyed my time with Raspberry Flavoured. I think the design and attention to the resource 
       economy and progression was stellar. Truly reworking the create mod into a brilliantly designed 
       progression. I can’t give this modpack more praise.
       Electrum, Shakudo, Hepatizon, and Divine Fragments were directly inspired by this mod; plus 
       much more!
    JermsyBoy
       My resource pack was made to mirror JermsyBoy’s original texture pack as closely as possible. I 
       thought he did great work but unfortunately has since stopped developing the project. Further, the 
       textures had copyright protections on them, thus my pack was made to mimic it whilst still allowing 
       everyone to modify and steal textures as they wish.
       His original texture pack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/a-little-taste-of-jerm 
       He also has a youtube channel, and has some stunning builds: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCICnSwa3x5sHTWmTP6YO30w 
    MiziraGamez
       Provided a framework for endless repairing (No XP cap)
       You can find their datapack here: https://modrinth.com/datapack/repair-cost-remover 
    Gooporeal
       Provided inspiration for the Lichen re-models I did
       Their resource pack: https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/gooporeals-lichen 
    Vectorwing
       Provided the inspiration for a lot of my textures 
       Their resourcepack: https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/detail-brush 
       (Gorgeous work)
    Rhythmic under PurpurMC
       Provided a framework for looting shears. 
       Their datapack: https://modrinth.com/datapack/purpurpacks-looting-shears?version=26.1&loader=datapack 


    [1] *These people do not know me nor endorse me.* I have been *inspired* by them. If you like this 
            video, you may also enjoy the work these people do.


 Music Attributions
    C418 (2011) Dog. Minecraft, Volume Alpha
    C418 (2011) Dry Hands. Minecraft, Volume Alpha
